ReadMe.Statement: DRAFT v0.1 — companion registry authored 2026-09-05 from the RATIFIED The flows section of the AIVIA Design Document (protocol step 2). The doc is the authority; any doc change updates this registry in the same breath. All build deferred by the phase ruling.

Three flows. Inbound = CONTRACT_DATALOAD + KG2 mapper rules (complete). Outward = produce/approve/land. Inward = match/ground/generate. No new node types or classes anywhere — choreography over ratified contracts.

Stages_and_Checks.Core rules (compressed; doc is authority: deterministic composition + bounded smoothing + class gate; staleness lens IS the worklist; writes machine versions only (append-as-proposal vs human-owned); generation-run event = only production ledger; replay floor
layer 3 machinery; surface writes dispositions ONLY

target-native rendering, zero custom attributes; B4: accepting disposition + named human confirmation per send; sent before transport; anti-repeat (R2); look-before-write (R3); observations append-only

one mind, free composition [M2,M3,M4]; match proposes evidence disposes [B1,B2]; completeness declared [B3]; outcomes matched|ambiguous|no-match (closed); ambiguity -> human [M5]; writes usage(asked) only
answer = arranged evidence, text is a caption; headlines/counts rendered by code; run rows DISPLAY-ONLY, never graph truth; writes usage(confirmed|ran) only

trigger = no-match + human request; drafts compose from L1 declared reality only (walk joins_to; deterministic validator); drafts display-only; the parser door is the only door; adoption/execution human-confirmed [B4]; provenance option c (unmarked v1)

CrossLayer_Acceptance.Cases: synthetic extract + synthetic estate -> layers 1-2 built -> produce -> approve -> land -> files match authored expectations
authored inquiry -> match -> ground -> answer cites only graph evidence; no-match case -> generate -> draft validates -> adopted file re-enters -> now matches
the two-denominator metric computable from working-set lens + L1

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: every run lands the GENERATION-RUN EVENT: author = agent identity; basis = model/prompt/lens/metamodel versions + worklist; accounting shipped u absent = attempted, one conservation line per class attempted (A9), killed-lines counted per shipped artifact
Rules_to_Checks.Check asserts: conservation event per run; the run event is the ONLY production ledger
Rules_to_Checks.v1: yes

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: the STALENESS LENS is the worklist (basis moved, no artifact yet, or explicit human request); nobody hand-picks; full regeneration = a version bump making everything stale — the same rule
Rules_to_Checks.v1: yes

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: deterministic composition + bounded model smoothing (linguistic seat only) + the class gate; the model never adds a fact
Rules_to_Checks.v1: yes

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: writes layer-3 machine versions ONLY; against human-owned artifacts it may APPEND a superseding version — rendered proposed by the ownership lens, never current
Rules_to_Checks.v1: yes

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: replay floor: same graph + same versions -> identical skeletons and gate verdicts; prose may vary, truth may not; model failure degrades to the deterministic floor
Rules_to_Checks.v1: yes

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: the approval surface WRITES DISPOSITIONS ONLY — it renders lenses, never touches artifacts, trees, or the technical layer
Rules_to_Checks.v1: yes

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: a send is an outward, irreversible act — it requires an accepting disposition on the artifact AND a named human confirmation of the send itself; no autonomy mode exempts it (B4)
Rules_to_Checks.Check asserts: no send without accepting disposition + human confirmation
Rules_to_Checks.v1: yes

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: anti-repeat: no send for logic whose current outcome is denied unless a new version exists (standing rule R2, read from the current-outcome lens)
Rules_to_Checks.v1: yes

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: every send lands a proposal SENT event before transport; every later look lands an OBSERVED event; current outcome is the lens
Rules_to_Checks.v1: yes

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: target-native forms only; ZERO custom attributes — native column sets held as data; attribution is the prefix in text, never a schema footprint
Rules_to_Checks.v1: yes

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: look-before-write: at send time read the ONE object about to be touched, never the catalog at large (R3); what was seen lands as an observed event
Rules_to_Checks.v1: yes

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: writes ONE thing — usage event asked, at inquiry arrival (every inquiry is a fact, especially unanswerable ones); nothing else, ever
Rules_to_Checks.v1: deferred (inward flow entire — no ask surface in v1)

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: outcomes, closed set: matched | ambiguous | no-match; no-match is typed and counted — the honest empty, never a shrug
Rules_to_Checks.v1: deferred (inward flow entire — no ask surface in v1)

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: completeness declared on every result: top-K is never 'all that exists'; enumeration questions use primitives that declare totality (B3)
Rules_to_Checks.v1: deferred (inward flow entire — no ask surface in v1)

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: match proposes, evidence disposes: output is candidate GRAPH OBJECTS (ids) + the evidence trail — never generated text posing as fact
Rules_to_Checks.Check asserts: candidates are ids + evidence, never text
Rules_to_Checks.v1: deferred (inward flow entire — no ask surface in v1)

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: ambiguous goes to the HUMAN with candidates (intent judgment is human's); no silent pick among near-ties
Rules_to_Checks.v1: deferred (inward flow entire — no ask surface in v1)

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: writes usage events only — confirmed when the human accepts, ran when they execute; run result rows are DISPLAY-ONLY and never enter the graph or the mind's evidence
Rules_to_Checks.v1: deferred (inward flow entire — no ask surface in v1)

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: the answer is ARRANGED EVIDENCE; the answer text is a CAPTION adding no claim the evidence doesn't carry
Rules_to_Checks.Check asserts: caption gate — no ungrounded claim in answer text
Rules_to_Checks.v1: deferred (inward flow entire — no ask surface in v1)

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: quantified claims inherit the match's declared completeness — 'all' and counts only over results declared total (B3)
Rules_to_Checks.v1: deferred (inward flow entire — no ask surface in v1)

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: headlines and counts are rendered by code from result metadata, never model-written
Rules_to_Checks.v1: deferred (inward flow entire — no ask surface in v1)

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: generated SQL composes only from declared reality — existing tables/columns, joins along declared joins_to paths (the builder WALKS the join graph), documented value sets; a deterministic validator checks every reference and join against layer 1 before the draft reaches the human
Rules_to_Checks.Check asserts: validator totality; refusals name the missing declared path
Rules_to_Checks.v1: deferred (inward flow entire — no ask surface in v1)

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: the parser door: a draft becomes estate ONLY by the human adopting it into their source and the inbound flow parsing it like any customer file — zero trust shortcuts
Rules_to_Checks.Check asserts: no side channel — the inbound door is the only door
Rules_to_Checks.v1: deferred (inward flow entire — no ask surface in v1)

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: the draft is DISPLAY-ONLY: delivered through the answer surface, writes nothing; a discarded draft leaves no residue
Rules_to_Checks.v1: deferred (inward flow entire — no ask surface in v1)

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: trigger: a no-match outcome AND an explicit human request — generation is an act someone asks for, never an automatic consolation
Rules_to_Checks.Check asserts: generation only on no-match + human request
Rules_to_Checks.v1: deferred (inward flow entire — no ask surface in v1)
